title: pi-agent run-dir settings
description: The SINGLE enable-list of LOCAL extension packages pi-agent bakes in. Used by both source mode (resolved against the workspace bun-apps/<name>/) and deploy mode (resolved against packages/<name>/). Replaces the old <repo>/.pi/settings.json `packages` list and deploy.config.json. npm: registry packages are NOT listed here — they load from the user-global agent dir (~/.pi/agent/npm) independently.

extensions.description: Workspace package names whose extensions/ pi-agent loads.
